correctness.rationale: The Gamma-moment basis calculation gives an exact single-diagonal operator. Taylor expansion of rational moment ratios yields the universal \(n^{-2}\) coefficient \((\alpha+1)(qr-ps)\); on proportional exponent vectors the next is \(-(\alpha+1)abuv(a-b)(u-v)n^{-3}\). Exhaustive cases with both coefficients zero commute algebraically. Sorting the absolute weights gives the singular asymptotics, sharp Schatten boundaries, and logarithmic residue. Exact symbolic/rational and independent finite-matrix comparisons are reproducible in checker.py; experiments do not replace the limit proof.
